title: Solar Impulse and BNP Paribas Switzerland: A strategic partnership
description: After making his incredible round-the-world flight without using one drop of fuel, on board Solar Impulse, Bertrand Piccard embarked on a new challenge with his Foundation, setting up the World Alliance for Efficient Solutions. The aim is to unveil at COP24 in one year's time 1000 economically viable environmental solutions designed to help governments fulfil their environmental commitments. BNP Paribas Switzerland decided to support this initiative and in November Bertrand Piccard met CEO Geoffroy Bazin. This was an important moment for the Alliance, marking the beginning of a strategic partnership.

After achieving this goal, the adventurer has set up a new challenge with his founder, which is to create the Global Alliance for Efficient Solutions. The goal is to send to COP24, in one year. 1,000 economically viable environmental solutions, which are designated for governments to realize their own solutions in the environment. But they're just not well known enough. Those who could use them. They haven't yet entered the mindset that environmental protection can be profitable. And that this is the biggest industrial market of the century. So actually, that's the work that needs to be done so that we can get these solutions to market. BNP Baribas Switzerland decided to support this initiative and in November, Bertrand Piccard met with CEO Geoffroy Bazin. We signed this partnership because BNP Paribas has decided as a strategy now to increase its responsibility side, its support side for the energy transition to renewable energy and has decided to divest itself of a number of fossil fuels, including non-conventional ones. So there is credibility. BNP Paribas Switzerland does not only see this as a financial partnership. The bank also offers its risk management expertise in the form of volunteering, volunteering skills, and they will be led to study solutions and look in particular at compliance risk on the solutions that will be presented. A real trust relationship that allows Bertrand Piccard to think about the future much more. I think we will reach more than 1000 solutions. We're going to see how we continue this action once we have the first 1,000, because I think we can very quickly set ourselves the goal of bringing in 5,000.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because its observable purpose is to present a strategic partnership supporting the World Alliance for Efficient Solutions, focused on renewable-energy transition and proposed solutions for governments. BNP Paribas is described as providing voluntary expertise and reviewing compliance risks, which is consistent with institutional collaboration rather than a financial scheme. The bank branding is promotional corporate context, but the material does not establish a deceptive offer, required financial participation, or promised return.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central observed context is an ordinary institutional partnership involving business support, volunteer expertise and compliance review for environmental solutions. The supplied evidence does not show a deceptive offer, required financial participation or promised investment return.
